en.name: YourTube: Watch & Discover
en.short_description: Video hub    like videos cloud server
en.subtitle: Stock video, worth watching
en.description:
YourTube is a clean way to watch high-quality stock video on your phone or TV.

WATCH
Browse trending and by category, search for what you want, or flick through short-form vertical video. The player supports captions, a queue, and a data-saver mode for when you are not on Wi-Fi.

FOR YOU
A recommendation feed that learns from what you watch. It is built on your activity in this app only, and you can see what it does in Settings.

SAVE IT
Watch Later holds anything you want to come back to. Clear it whenever.

MADE FOR THE BIG SCREEN TOO
YourTube detects a TV and switches to a layout you can drive with a remote.

Sign in with Google or Apple to keep your list across devices, or browse without an account. YourTube shows ads.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing YourTube.

Sign-in is required. The router redirects every route to the login screen until a session exists (authRedirect in lib/config/routes.dart) and there is no guest or skip path in the interface, so please use the demo credentials supplied in the App Review demo-account fields of this submission with the email-and-password form. "Sign in with Apple" also works and creates the account through our Supabase backend. One caveat: the "Use test account" button under the form is for internal QA builds only - it reads build-time credentials that a shipped binary does not contain, so in this build it does nothing but re-validate the form. Please use the supplied credentials instead.

What the app plays: third-party stock video, not user uploads. There is no camera, no microphone, no upload path, no live streaming and no commenting, and no camera or microphone permission is declared. If this build was compiled without a Pexels API key, every feed falls back to a bundled catalogue of 20 sample entries; each of those entries has its own title and thumbnail but plays the same short public-domain clip, and their view and like counts are generated numbers rather than real ones. Thumbnails are still loaded over the network in that mode, so the feed needs a connection either way.

Ads: AdMob banners sit on the home feed and below the player, requested only after the UMP consent flow at launch. The iOS banner ad unit is not configured in this build, so on iPhone the slot shows a grey "Advertisement" placeholder strip instead of an ad. The app never calls requestTrackingAuthorization and does not read the advertising identifier, so no App Tracking Transparency prompt appears.

Test instructions:
1. Sign in with the supplied demo credentials.
2. Home: trending rows and a category strip. Tap a video to open the player - play/pause, 10-second skip back and forward, like, dislike, share, save and subscribe.
3. Shorts tab: vertical swipe-through short video.
4. Search for anything, and use Categories for the fifteen built-in categories.
5. For You builds recommendations on the device from your watch and search history (lib/data/services/recommendation_engine.dart). Watch two or three videos, then open For You to see the list change. Nothing about your viewing is uploaded for this.
6. Save a video, open the Watch Later tab, and swipe a row to remove it.
7. Settings has captions, data saver, video quality, notifications and sign-out.

Privacy:
• Data collected: your email address, or the Apple / Google identity you sign in with, held by our Supabase authentication backend. Watch history, search history, the watch-later list and every preference stay on the device in shared_preferences.
• Network: video metadata and thumbnails from Pexels, playback from the video's own host, authentication with Supabase, and ad requests to Google AdMob.
• Tracking: no App Tracking Transparency prompt is shown and the advertising identifier is not read.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
